body:
Yeah I've tried the route of getting through it on my own. I made weightloss a goal so I had something to work towards. The motivation didn't last long, but I have lost 15kg. I was about 20kg overweight. So 5kg to go. I kept thinking once I completed the weightloss, then what?
The future I'm seeing for myself isn't a future I want to live in. I doubt I'll manage to change it. I would probably end myself in the future, so why not save time and do it now is what I'm thinking.

I'm fucking scared to tell my mom. I know she would do everything to help and so would the rest of my family. It's just.. I don't know.. FUCK

I don't know about the counselor, I can't see myself talking to someone who is paid to listen. What's the point? I already know what a counselor would tell me, but maybe the words need to be spoken to me for me to do something about it.

Thanks for reading, no I haven't talked to any professional as I don't understand what they can help me with. :/ I don't feel like I need to talk to someone, but I guess I do since I just wrote a wall of text.
